thought.title: GELU Baseline: Proven AscendC Kernel (verbatim from original)
thought.description: Established baseline using the proven working GELU AscendC kernel. Implementation uses: DEFAULT_BLOCK_M=128 rows per block, KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIC_1_2 (1 AIC+2 AIV), TQue depth=0 for in-place I/O, TBuf VECCALC for fp32 intermediates, AscendC::Tanh for activation, DataCopy 1D element-count for GM↔UB transfers. Supports fp16/fp32/bf16.
thought.reason: Starting from a known-correct implementation ensures we have a reliable baseline. The original kernel's sub-1.0x speedup vs PyTorch indicates optimization headroom in tiling parameters and memory access patterns.
thought.target_bottleneck: GM↔UB bandwidth, suboptimal block size for large rows
